purpose: Freeze a market-aligned nominal mission-duration target and correct controller electrical-speed capability so it remains above the frozen 80 V / 45 KV / 42-pole propulsion envelope. PWM itself remains OPEN until motor-inductance evidence exists.

change_control.rule: PB-04 inherits PB-03 unless a PB-04 decision explicitly supersedes an inherited value. Any later change to a PB-04 frozen value requires PB-05 or an explicitly linked engineering change record; no silent overwrite is allowed.

summary: X8 coaxial / eight independent propulsion channels
18S 66.6 V nominal convention / 75.6 V full charge / <=80 V outer input ceiling
>=70 A continuous DC and >=200 A for >=3 s DC capability
>=4.8 kW continuous and >=11.5 kW short-duration input capability
>=125 A RMS continuous phase current, >=265 A RMS for >=3 s and >=375 A instantaneous phase peak
phase-current measurement range at least -400 A to +400 A
power-up/reset DISARMED and no automatic re-arm after fault

superseded_inherited_decisions.reason: The previous 60 keRPM capability was based on the 2478 rpm loaded manufacturer curve. It did not bound the frozen 80 V outer bus ceiling combined with the 45 rpm/V, 42-pole reference class. The no-load linear screen is 80*45*21 = 75,600 eRPM, so 90 keRPM is adopted as controller capability headroom. This is a control-capability requirement, not an expected loaded flight speed.

new_frozen_decisions.rationale: At the frozen outer input ceiling, 80 V * 45 rpm/V = 3600 rpm mechanical no-load linear screen. With 42 poles / 21 pole pairs this is 75,600 eRPM. A >=90,000 eRPM controller capability provides about 19% headroom above that screen and avoids tying the controller limit to one loaded manufacturer curve point.

new_frozen_decisions.reference_condition: 85 kg nominal payload / 165 kg nominal MTOW design target; reference-condition sizing target, not a measured endurance claim
new_frozen_decisions.rationale: A 10-minute rated target is consistent with current heavy-lift market endurance while retaining room for an explicit energy reserve instead of sizing to battery depletion.

new_frozen_decisions.reference_condition: 165 kg nominal MTOW design target using current X13 G2 reference propulsion curve
new_frozen_decisions.rationale: Using hover-equivalent time for first-order pack sizing is intentionally conservative for the slow agricultural/utility mission profile until a detailed mission power trace is frozen.
Pack energy is sized with at least 20% energy margin beyond the nominal mission-energy calculation. This is a sizing reserve, not yet the firmware low-battery cutoff or BMS SOC threshold.

pwm_status.reason_open: Exact production motor Ld/Lq or equivalent PWM ripple inductance is still unavailable; switching-loss screen is parameterized but cannot substitute for ripple evidence.

remaining_s1_critical_open_items: PWM frequency/current ripple final closure after exact motor inductance evidence
18S exact Ah/Wh/minimum-loaded-bus/sag/BMS behavior and pack mass allocation
exact 150 V MOSFET MPN and parallel count
current-sense implementation, DC-link, precharge and thermal architecture
anti_hallucination_rule: PB-04 mission values are controlled product targets and the energy figures are sizing calculations. They are not measured endurance. The 90 keRPM value is controller capability, not a claim that the propeller will operate at that speed. PWM remains OPEN.
